data.name: Cindrel
data.description:
Cindrel are small folk born near old hearths, their skin warm to the touch.

Warm Blood. You have Resistance to Cold damage.

Hearth Sight. You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Warm Blood
traits.text: You have Resistance to Cold damage.

traits.text: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

data.name: Lantern Keeper
data.equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Lantern, Ash Chalk, Traveler's Clothes, 12 GP; or (B) 50 GP

data.name: Ashen Resolve
data.description:
You gain the following benefit.

Keep the Flame. When you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, you can drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

data.name: Ember Lance
data.description:
A spear of glowing embers flies at one creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 Fire damage.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

data.name: Lantern of Quiet Flame
data.description: This lantern burns without oil. Its light fills a 20-foot Emanation, and creatures more than 60 feet away can't see the light.

data.name: Ash Chalk
data.description: A stick of grey chalk that leaves a mark only firelight shows.
